label: Award Badge
purpose: Display a trust-building award or bestseller badge above the fold
_notes: award_number is a short rank/label like '#1'; award_title is the main claim (e.g. 'BESTSELLER OF 2025'); award_subtitle is a short supporting line. All three are plain text, not richtext. All color settings (accent, text, background, border) are pure visual styling and intentionally excluded.
